question: In a certain code language, 'HANG' is coded as 'LSFM'. What is the code for 'GRAW' in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘HANG' is coded as 'LSFM’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e98d0c0d2d884f321e02992af21db97ce8c4821831b32369f90cf8373a858405.png] 

Similarly, for '**GRAW**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01f6efd56ba11751910b70bad5d932c0f6498aba6b67818f1d08da7efbfc1973.png] 

So, 'GRAW' will be coded as '**BFWL**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
